## Scope

- [ ] Change stays within the owning Code boundary.
- [ ] No frozen contract changed without approved architecture review.

## Verification

- [ ] Format, lint and typecheck
- [ ] Unit and contract tests
- [ ] Migration tests when data changes
- [ ] Dependency direction, secret and license checks
- [ ] Build/package smoke where applicable
- [ ] New dependency/model/binary/action has exact source, version, hash, license and redistribution review
- [ ] Release/packaging changes identify the exact artifact and do not claim branch artifact as main evidence

## Release and compliance impact

State `NONE`, or describe SBOM/NOTICE/model/binary/provider/signing/Windows E2E impact and required follow-up.

## Architecture question

State `NONE`, or link the approved Architecture Question / ADR.
